subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) HF−DB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37f0ef149c8c2a7e2848c3c4ee055efac2827ee37366d93c19e64d3d42f5cc51.png] 

Option 2) DB−ZX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa2980cfc6da84b554c32cb27355788224844e797c3501c8ed2b6a91e5813f4a.png] 

Option 3) VT−RP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e4fa9a6d9c7e1eb718f7ab5d7941d3ad52bd259773d3f37be0a130eeb23767.png] 

**Option 4) OM−JK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5210561b217c6267b8bc2103570b6c4959ac1434648a166c4c7cd036792a423e.png] 

Here, 'OM−JK' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
